environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules applied in priority order. Priority 1: a custom rule matching path pattern /api/users/search with a fixed query-string condition requiring the presence of a 'token' key, forwarding to the target group. Priority 2: AWS WAF WebACL association with rule group containing (a) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to BLOCK for query strings exceeding 128 bytes, and (b) a custom regex-match rule on query string values using pattern `['";\-\-]|UNION|SELECT|OR\s+\d+=\d+` with BLOCK action and priority 0 (evaluated first). The ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS proxy endpoint (not relevant here but noted). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite DB is mounted from an EFS volume with uid-restricted access.

config.ecs_task_network: egress restricted to VPC endpoints only
config.container_filesystem: read-only root, EFS mount at /var/lib/app with uid=1000 restriction
